dedupe_keys.name: bfn map application urban ecosystems in germany eu nature restoration regulation article 8

description: The Federal Agency for Nature Conservation publishes a map application, Urban ecosystems in Germany, that shows nationwide information and data in the context of Article 8 of the EU Nature Restoration Regulation, the article on restoring urban ecosystems. The application is launched from the BfN data and facts page and runs in the BfN geodata viewer, and the page links to the agency's topic page on nature restoration; questions go to the BfN unit for nature conservation information, geoinformation and open data. Access is free and public; no licence is stated on the page read. Caveats: the page gives only a short description, the viewer is rendered by scripts so its layers could not be listed from the cloud session, and the pages are in German. Coverage is Germany, at the level of urban areas. It supports green infrastructure planning and the monitoring of urban green space and tree cover for climate adaptation, for example for heat and stormwater; related records are the Copernicus tree cover layer and the Urban Nature Atlas.
